about: Messy-intake phrasings for abr-itsm-queue (spec author Opus 5.5, 2026-11-04). One {v} per phrase; $0 lint plus paid 3-model panel (intake.py). Status: panel pending.
open: Hi! Can we get the service desk queue automated? Rough requirements:
Following the ITSM review, this is what the queue bot should do (draft)
ok so the incident queue keeps slipping, here's the ask
noise: The CMDB export is a week stale, don't rely on it.
(Night shift will still triage by hand sometimes.)
We might move to a new ticketing tool next year, ignore that for now.
Reassignments happen a lot; they don't change anything for the bot.
